AUTHOR: Chen
TITLE: From snapshots to continuous estimates: Augmenting citizen science with computer vision for fish monitoring
VENUE: Remote Sensing in Ecology and Conservation
REGION: Coonamessett, Ipswich and Santuit Rivers, Massachusetts, USA (fish ladders / river reach)
SPECIES: river herring vs non-river herring (other fish and objects)
DATA: Own fishway/river camera video 2015–2018 (Ipswich), 2024 (Coonamessett), Santuit; 1435 labelled clips, 59,850 frames
V_EV: Results: 'Video quality varied across the three rivers despite using the same camera model, primarily due to different background set-up, lighting condition, water clarity'
D2: 80/10/10 stratified by class and time of day; frames within same 30-min period kept in same split
D_EV: Training dataset: 'video frames within the same 30-min period were also ensured to be in the same split to avoid data leakage'
R_EV: Table 1: river-specific models 'performed best when applied to their corresponding river ... None of the individual models performed well on external sites (mAP at 2–61.8%)'
C_EV: DISCount and S1wRS: 'used DISCount (k = 700) to correct the counts and estimated 34,338 ± 11,446 fish'; Fig. 6 'Shaded ribbons represent 95% CI'
E_EV: Compare with PIT-tag data: 'served as a valuable validation approach to evaluate potential false negatives in the CV detections'; 'in only 1.9% of intervals, CV counted fewer fish'
ARCH: YOLOv11 + BoT-SORT tracking + line-crossing counter + DISCount importance-sampling correction
METR: mAP@0.5 (in-site, cross-site, cross-year), count agreement with human review, stream-side counts and PIT-tag detections; run size estimates
NOTE: Cross-site (3 rivers with different set-ups) and cross-year (Ipswich 2015–2018) evaluations of site/year-specific models give R1=Y, R3=Y; combined model test is in-domain. Split: clips stratified; 30-min grouping to avoid leakage -> D1=영상(video), D3=Y (temporal grouping), D4=Y. C3=기타 for DISCount count estimates with SE/95% CI; C5 for stated duplicate-handling rule ('If a fish crossed the boundary multiple times, only its final movement direction was recorded'); human review of a 10% DISCount sample compares counts but no explicit FP rate. No confidence threshold value reported. E1=복수: run size, daily/hourly migration timing and pattern. Independent references: PIT-tag antenna and stream-side volunteer visual counts; also same-footage human review. E4=FNR from PIT-interval comparison (interval-level). Low-light associated with missed detections (qualitative, V6=P); fish distance 50–120 cm (V4).
